name: New Clark City Marathon 2026
short_description: A full marathon and multi-distance race set for August 16, 2026 at New Clark City in Capas, Tarlac, Philippines.
ai_summary: The New Clark City Marathon 2026 is a full-marathon event scheduled for August 16, 2026, in Capas, Tarlac, Philippines, hosted at the New Clark City venue. Organized by Run The North, the race offers four distance options: 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, catering to a range of runner abilities. Registration details have not yet been announced.
pros: Multiple distance options (42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, 5km) for different fitness levels
Hosted at the purpose-built New Clark City venue
Organized by an established organizer, Run The North
cons: Registration status has not yet been announced

faqs.question: When is the New Clark City Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The New Clark City Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on August 16, 2026. It will be held at the New Clark City venue located in Capas, Tarlac, in the Philippines, offering runners a fixed date to plan their training and travel arrangements around.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the New Clark City Marathon 2026?

faqs.question: Who organizes the New Clark City Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The New Clark City Marathon 2026 is organized by Run The North. They are responsible for coordinating the event, which takes place at the New Clark City venue in Capas, Tarlac, Philippines, across the four available race distances on August 16, 2026.
